description:
Turn ChatGPT into a secure, natively multilingual workplace with LILT—enterprise infrastructure for verified translation, custom AI models, and expert human review.

LILT connects your chat interface directly to your brand’s language assets, automated quality gates, and enterprise translation workflows via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Generate verified, policy-compliant content, enforce corporate glossaries, and route high-stakes assets to professional human reviewers without ever leaving ChatGPT.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-Time AI Verification: Automatically validate translations for accuracy, terminology, and brand voice using built-in AI QA agents.
- Calibrated Quality Gates: Run instant AI validation for daily communications, or trigger expert human review for mission-critical content.
- Custom Enterprise Models: Translate using domain-adapted LLMs tuned specifically to your company terminology and style guides.
- Live Terminology Sync: Access corporate glossaries and translation memories directly inside your chat thread.
- In-Chat Project Management: Launch translation jobs, track pipeline progress, and pull completed assets straight into your conversation.
- Enterprise Security & Governance: Enforce data isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), and full audit trails.

defaultPrompt: Translate this attached onboarding document into French using LILT human-verified translation.
Ask LILT for our localization program analytics, including AI translation accuracy and on-time delivery trends.
Show me the active LILT data sources and fine-tuned translation models I have access to.
